brief:
Jerusalem Electricity holds the largest subscriber base among power distribution companies operating in its service area, according to Maan Wire. The utility's dominant position reflects its control over a substantially greater portion of customers compared to rival distributors in the region.

The company's commanding market share underscores its central role in electricity distribution infrastructure. Jerusalem Electricity serves as the primary supplier to households and businesses across its operational territory, maintaining significantly higher subscription numbers than other competing distribution firms.
title: Jerusalem Electricity claims largest share of distribution subscribers
